routes.label: Divide total distance by total time

question: A car travels \(120\) miles from \(A\) to \(B\) at \(30\) miles per hour but returns the same distance at \(40\) miles per hour. The average speed for the round trip is closest to:
solution:
Average speed is total distance divided by total travel time. First find the time for each leg:
\[
\frac{120}{30}=4\text{ hours},\qquad \frac{120}{40}=3\text{ hours}.
\]
The car travels \(240\) miles in \(7\) hours, so its average speed is
\[
\frac{240}{7}=34\frac{2}{7}\approx34.29\text{ mph}.
\]
This lies between \(34\) and \(34.5\) mph, so the closest listed speed is \(34\) mph, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
